dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I wish you a good day at work.

dialogues.speaker: Cassigneul
dialogues.text: Thank you. I have every faith that my project here will proceed smoothly. I believe in this harbor and everyone who works here.

dialogues.speaker: Cassigneul
dialogues.text: Speaking of which, please take these gifts. Once again, I welcome you to Lumidouce Harbor and wish you a pleasant journey.
